description: This file is a header file defining WebSocket connection status APIs for libwebsockets, including function declarations for checking socket writeability, message fragments, reserved bits, buffering status, and message type.

methods.name: lws_send_pipe_choked
methods.description: Checks if the socket is writable; determines if more data can be sent on the websocket connection.

methods.name: lws_is_final_fragment
methods.description: Tests if the current WebSocket message fragment is the final fragment.

methods.name: lws_is_first_fragment
methods.description: Tests if the current WebSocket message fragment is the first fragment.

methods.name: lws_get_reserved_bits
methods.description: Accesses the reserved bits of the WebSocket frame.

methods.name: lws_partial_buffered
methods.description: Checks if the last write on the connection is buffered and not yet completed.

methods.name: lws_frame_is_binary
methods.description: Determines if the current frame was sent in binary mode.
